note: top navigation bar -- renders fixed platform navigation, search, help, logo, sign-up and sign-in controls; the site-switcher navigation is excluded
site header -- renders the platform's fixed site identity, excluding the advertisement slot
left navigation -- renders fixed platform navigation and operator-authored marketing and account controls
question action area -- renders the fixed Ask Question control
question save control -- renders the fixed Save action
share controls -- render the fixed platform sharing action
answer save controls -- render the fixed Save action
comment controls -- render the fixed Add comment action
answers header -- renders the fixed Answers section label and answer sort controls
related-questions heading -- renders the fixed Related heading
advertisement reporting controls -- render the fixed platform Report this ad action
site footer -- renders fixed platform navigation, policy links, social links and footer metadata
